en: A vintage postcard depicting a historic, three-story wooden building with prominent bay windows and ornate trim. The corner of the building has a small balcony and several exterior staircases. There is a wooden sidewalk and a telephone pole in front. The text at the top right reads 'Revere House, Albany, Ore.', and handwritten numbers are present on the left side of the image.
